name: Four Seasons Cabo San Lucas @ Cabo del Sol
positioning: Hacienda-style beachfront resort on Cabo's Golden Corridor, with a swimmable beach on the Sea of Cortez
best_for: Travelers who want a swimmable beach and a spa at a beachfront resort
Families, with a Kids For All Seasons program that is complimentary for ages 4 to 12

facts.text: The resort is at Carretera Transpeninsular Km 10.3, Cabo del Sol, Cabo San Lucas.
The resort is on Cabo's Golden Corridor, between Cabo San Lucas and San Jose Del Cabo.
The resort is a modern hacienda-style village.
The resort has three restaurants and five bars.
The resort has three swimming pools.
Tierra Mar Spa has 10 treatment rooms.
The Fitness Studio was designed in partnership with trainer Harley Pasternak.

highlights.text: The resort has a swimmable beach on the Sea of Cortez.
From December to April, guests can watch for humpback whales just off the resort's shore.
Cayao by Richard Sandoval serves Nikkei cuisine, a fusion of Japanese and Peruvian flavours.
Casitas and Villas offer the option of a private plunge pool.
The Kids For All Seasons program is complimentary for ages 4 to 12.

considerations.text: The resort is 15 minutes by car from the Marina in downtown Cabo San Lucas.
The Cabo Del Sol golf course is a short golf cart ride from the resort.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
